info.name: Druid Forms
info.description: Cat Form and Bear Form for the Circle of the Moon from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

element.name: Level 2: Cat Form and Bear Form

description.p: The beast forms that every druid in World of Warcraft learns are Cat Form, Bear Form, and Travel Form. If you have the Circle of the Moon subclass, when you use Wild Shape you can adopt the Cat Form (feral druids) or Bear Form (guardian druids) stat blocks below.
2014 rules: when you take on one of these forms with Wild Shape, the form’s Hit Points equal 3 times your Druid level; when they drop to 0 you revert to your normal form, as with any Wild Shape form.

Without the Circle of the Moon, you can become a Panther at level 2 and a Tiger at level 8 (Cat Form), a Black Bear at level 4 and a Brown Bear at level 8 (Bear Form), and an Elk starting at level 2 (Travel Form). For fast swimming, consider a Giant Seahorse starting at level 4 (or level 3 for the Circle of the Moon). When you gain access to flying forms at level 8, you can become an Eagle, a Giant Bat, a Hawk, a Pteranodon, or a Raven.

p.em: Medium; Your Creature Type And Alignment Don’t Change. Requires Circle Forms.

description.p: AC 13 + your Wisdom modifier; Hit Points 3 times your Druid level; Speed 40 ft.
Str., Dex. Your Strength and Dexterity scores are equal to your Wisdom score. Con., Int., Wis., Cha. Your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma don’t change.
Skills You have proficiency in Stealth.
Senses Darkvision 60 ft.; Languages Your languages don’t change; CR – (Your Proficiency Bonus doesn’t change.)
Multiattack. You make one Pounce attack and use Prowl.

Pounce. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach Druid levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10). If you had Advantage on the attack roll, the target takes an extra 1d6 Slashing damage and, if it is Large or smaller, has the Prone condition. The extra damage increases by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 6 (2d6), 9 (3d6), 12 (4d6), 15 (5d6), and 18 (6d6).

Primal Wrath. You expend a level 1+ spell slot and slash nearby enemies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you. Failure: 2d6 Slashing damage per spell slot level expended plus your Wisdom modifier.
Prowl. You move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, you can take the Hide action.

p.em: Large; Your Creature Type And Alignment Don’t Change. Requires Circle Forms.

description.p: AC 15 + your Wisdom modifier; Hit Points 3 times your Druid level; Speed 30 ft.
Str., Dex. Your Strength and Dexterity scores are equal to your Wisdom score. Con., Int., Wis., Cha. Your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma don’t change.
Senses Darkvision 60 ft.; Languages Your languages don’t change; CR – (Your Proficiency Bonus doesn’t change.)
Multiattack. You make two Mangle attacks.

Mangle. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage. This damage increases by 1d8 when you reach Druid levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
Frenzied Regeneration. You expend a level 1+ spell slot and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to five times the spell slot level.

Growl. Trigger: A creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you. Response: You impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 feet of the target.

sheet.description: Wild Shape: Cat Form (Medium, AC 13 + {{wisdom:modifier}}, HP 3 × Druid level, Speed 40 ft., Pounce + Prowl, Primal Wrath) or Bear Form (Large, AC 15 + {{wisdom:modifier}}, HP 3 × Druid level, Speed 30 ft., two Mangle attacks, Frenzied Regeneration, Growl). Str and Dex equal your Wisdom.
